_comment: Operations a provider's published document declares and its Go SDK never wrapped, so the surface scan cannot see them and `unknown: 0` is exact over a set that does not contain them (#622). Each entry states whether it is out of scope or not done yet, because this repository holds those to be different answers. Read by `feint coverage --contract-only`; an entry with no reason, or an operation missing from this file, exits 2 the way an upstream addition does.

scaleway.reason: the emulator accepts every credential on purpose, so serving users, policies and keys would describe an access control that nothing here enforces — the same reason the pack already declines the rest of iam/v1alpha1, and this is the read side of it

the PUT whole-object sibling of UpdateImage, which this pack serves. No client built on scaleway-sdk-go can reach it, because the SDK never wrapped it, but a client generated from the portal document can and #622 came from one
the PUT whole-object sibling of UpdateSecurityGroup, which this pack serves. Reachable only by a client generated from the portal document, never by scaleway-sdk-go
the PUT whole-object sibling of UpdateSecurityGroupRule, which this pack serves. Reachable only by a client generated from the portal document, never by scaleway-sdk-go
the PUT whole-object sibling of UpdateSnapshot, which this pack serves. Reachable only by a client generated from the portal document, never by scaleway-sdk-go
the PUT whole-object sibling of UpdateVolume, which this pack serves. Reachable only by a client generated from the portal document, never by scaleway-sdk-go

POST .../private-network-interfaces/{id}/detach-and-delete, in the portal document on 2026-09-06 and not wrapped by scaleway-sdk-go at cb7f357, so no client built on the SDK (scw, the Terraform provider) can reach it yet; surfaced by the contract refresh #631 made. The pack serves this family: the v2alpha1 reads (privatenics_v2alpha1.go) and the v1 detach. The day the SDK wraps it, the scan puts it in front of the triage
